mods.title: Mods of {world}
mods.no_account: Mod downloads are off because Foreman has no factorio.com account. Searching still works.
mods.search.heading: Find a mod
mods.search.label: Mod name
mods.search.hint: Searches the mod portal for mods made for Factorio {line}, the game version of this world.
mods.search.missing: Enter part of a mod's name to search for.
mods.search.title: Mods matching "{query}" for {world}
mods.search.unreachable: Foreman could not reach the mod portal, so it could not search. Try again in a moment.
mods.search.none: No mod for Factorio {line} matches. Try a shorter part of the name.
mods.search.pick_hint: Tick several mods to add them to one plan, or use a mod's own Add to plan button.
mods.search.pick_none: Nothing is ticked. Tick the mods to add, or use a mod's own Add to plan button.
mods.search.pick_too_many: Too many mods are ticked for one plan. The limit is {limit}. Untick some, then add them.
mods.search.ticked_elsewhere: Also ticked in other searches or on other pages
mods.portal.for: for {mod}, opens in a new tab
mods.installed.heading: Installed mods
mods.installed.none: This world has only the mods built into the game. Find a mod above to install one.
mods.installed.portal: on the mod portal, opens in a new tab
mods.row.gone: Players cannot join: the mod portal no longer has version {version}, so their game cannot download it.
mods.row.gone_none: Players cannot join: the mod portal no longer has version {version} and has none for this game version. Remove the mod or disable it.
mods.row.deprecated: Deprecated on the mod portal, so players cannot find it in the game's mod browser.
mods.row.not_on_portal: Not on the mod portal, so players' games cannot download it. Players need the file from you.
mods.status.loading: Checking the mod portal for updates…
mods.status.unreachable: Foreman could not reach the mod portal, so it could not check for updates or for mods players cannot download.

mods.status.errors.one: {count} mod stops players joining. Its row says how to fix it.
mods.status.errors.other: {count} mods stop players joining. Their rows say how to fix them.

mods.status.warnings.one: {count} mod is deprecated on the mod portal.
mods.status.warnings.other: {count} mods are deprecated on the mod portal.

mods.status.notes.one: {count} mod is not on the mod portal.
mods.status.notes.other: {count} mods are not on the mod portal.

mods.status.updates.one: {count} mod has an update for this game version.
mods.status.updates.other: {count} mods have an update for this game version.

mods.status.current.one: {count} mod from the mod portal is up to date.
mods.status.current.other: All {count} mods from the mod portal are up to date.

mods.notice.one: {count} mod of {world} can no longer be downloaded by players, so they cannot join.
mods.notice.other: {count} mods of {world} can no longer be downloaded by players, so they cannot join.

mods.notice.one: {mod} {version} is gone from the mod portal, so players cannot join.
mods.sync.heading: Match mods to the save
mods.sync.text: Makes the world's mods the ones the save {save} was made with: installs the missing ones, changes versions, and disables the rest. You see the plan first.
mods.sync.differ: The mods differ from the save {save}:

mods.sync.missing.one: {count} mod the save uses is not installed
mods.sync.missing.other: {count} mods the save uses are not installed

mods.sync.off.one: {count} mod the save uses is disabled here
mods.sync.off.other: {count} mods the save uses are disabled here

mods.sync.version.one: {count} mod the save uses is installed at another version
mods.sync.version.other: {count} mods the save uses are installed at another version

mods.sync.extra.one: {count} enabled mod is not in the save
mods.sync.extra.other: {count} enabled mods are not in the save

mods.sync.what: Matching installs the missing mods, changes versions and disables the rest. You see the plan first.
mods.sync.no_save: This world has no save yet, so there is nothing to match.
mods.sync.offer: Match the mods to the save
mods.sync.import: Match this world's mods to its save
mods.upload.heading: Upload a mod
mods.upload.text: Install a mod from a .zip file you have.
mods.upload.label: Mod zip
mods.upload.hint: A mod's .zip file, at most {limit}. Foreman reads its name and version from its info.json and shows the plan before it changes anything.
mods.upload.not_mod: This file is not a mod zip: it has no readable info.json in a folder at its top level. Choose the mod's .zip file.
mods.upload.bad_name: The mod's info.json gives a name or version Foreman cannot use as a file name. Choose another file.
mods.upload.wrong_mod: This zip holds {got}, not {mod}. Choose the zip of {mod}.
mods.settings.heading: Mod settings
mods.settings.text: The values of the mods' settings live in {file}. Download it to keep a copy or to use it in another world.
mods.settings.none: This world has no {file} yet. The game writes one when it first runs with mods.
mods.settings.where: Your Factorio client keeps it in its mods folder: Windows {windows}, macOS {macos}, Linux {linux}.
mods.settings.apply: Startup settings apply when the world next starts.
mods.settings.apply_running: Startup settings apply when the world next starts, so Foreman restarts it.
mods.settings.replace: Replace {file} with the file you choose.
mods.settings.label: New {file}
mods.settings.empty: This file is empty. Choose a mod-settings.dat file.
mods.settings.changed: The world's mods changed after this page opened, so nothing was changed. Check the page, then upload the file again.
mods.plan.heading.sync: Match the mods of {world} to the save {save}?
mods.plan.changed: The plan changed since you saw it, because the mods of {world} or the mod portal changed. Nothing was changed. This is the new plan; check it, then confirm again.

mods.plan.conflicts.one: This plan cannot be applied because of a conflict:
mods.plan.conflicts.other: This plan cannot be applied because of {count} conflicts:

mods.plan.busy: Wait for it to finish, then open this plan again.

mods.plan.no_account.one: This plan downloads {count} mod, and downloads are off because Foreman has no factorio.com account.
mods.plan.no_account.other: This plan downloads {count} mods, and downloads are off because Foreman has no factorio.com account.

mods.plan.nothing: Nothing needs to change: the mods are already as asked.
mods.version.hint: Only releases for Factorio {line}, the game version of this world, are listed. Choosing another one draws the plan again.
mods.version.label: Version of {mod}
mods.version.same: Nothing changes at this version. Choose another version to see what would change.
mods.plan.warn_stop: Warn the players, then save and stop the server.
mods.plan.snapshot: Take a snapshot of {world}, labeled "{label}". If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
mods.plan.add.heading: Add another mod
mods.plan.undo: When it is done, a one-click Undo appears with the result, which restores that snapshot.
mods.plan.item.name: {mod} {version}
mods.plan.why.not_in_save: the save does not use it
mods.plan.warn.older: This release is older than the one the save was made with.
mods.optional.hint: A mod in the plan can use these, but does not need them. Tick one to add it, with anything it needs.
mods.recommended.hint: Mods marked as recommended start ticked. Untick one to leave it out.
mods.recommended.unavailable: {mod}, recommended by {of}, is left out: the mod portal has no version that fits.
mods.unresolved.legend: The mod portal does not have {mod} {version}
mods.unresolved.hint: The save was made with this version. Choose what to do; the plan cannot be applied until you do.
mods.unresolved.nearest_hint: Nearest means the closest release for Factorio {line}.
mods.unresolved.nearest: Use {mod} {version}, the nearest release for Factorio {line}
mods.unresolved.confirm: I understand that when the save loads without {mod}, the game deletes everything {mod} added to the world. The snapshot "{label}" keeps a copy.
mods.unresolved.confirm_missing: Tick the box to confirm that the game will delete what {mod} added, or choose another option for {mod}.

mods.drops.warning.one: The save that loads uses {mods}, which this change disables. Without it, the game deletes everything {mods} built in the world.
mods.drops.warning.other: The save that loads uses {count} mods this change disables: {mods}. Without them, the game deletes everything they built in the world.

mods.drops.confirm_missing.one: Tick the box to confirm that the game deletes what this mod built, or cancel.
mods.drops.confirm_missing.other: Tick the box to confirm that the game deletes what these {count} mods built, or cancel.

mods.conflict.space_age_off: {mod} needs {other}, which comes with Space Age, and Space Age is off for this world.
mods.conflict.space_age_save: The save uses {mod}, which comes with Space Age, and Space Age is off for this world. Turn Space Age on in the world's settings first.
mods.conflict.no_release: No release of {mod} for this game version meets what the plan needs: {needs}.
mods.conflict.no_such_release: The mod portal has no release {version} of {mod} for this game version. Choose another version.
mods.conflict.version: {mod} {version} does not meet what the plan needs: {needs}.
mods.conflict.not_on_portal: {mod} is not on the mod portal. Upload its zip instead.
mods.conflict.built_in: {mod} is built into the game. It follows the world's Space Age setting and is not changed by hand.
mods.conflict.local: {mod} is installed as a folder, and Foreman never replaces a folder mod. Change it in the world's mods folder.
mods.conflict.not_installed: {mod} is not installed in this world.
mods.conflict.bad_dependency: {mod} lists a dependency Foreman cannot read: {text}.
mods.conflict.too_complex: The mods' dependencies are too tangled for Foreman to work out. Install the mods one at a time.
mods.conflict.bad_request: Foreman cannot make this change. Go back to the mods and start again.
mods.error.unreadable: Foreman cannot read this world's files, so it cannot change its mods.
mods.error.portal: Foreman could not reach the mod portal, so it could not work out the plan. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
mods.error.staged_gone: The uploaded zip is no longer on the server, for example after Foreman restarts. Nothing was changed. Upload it again.
mods.error.no_save: This world has no save, so there are no mods to match. Upload a save first.
mods.error.save_gone: The save is no longer in the world. Nothing was changed. Open the plan again from the Mods tab.
mods.error.save_unreadable: Foreman could not read the mod list in the save, so it cannot match the mods. Nothing was changed.
mods.error.plan: Foreman could not work out the plan. Nothing was changed. The log has the details.
mods.error.changed: The world's mods changed after the plan was made, so nothing was changed. Open the mods again to see the new plan.
mods.error.built_in: Built-in mods follow the world's Space Age setting and are not changed by hand. Nothing was changed.
mods.error.local: One of these mods is installed as a folder, and Foreman never replaces a folder mod. Nothing was changed.
mods.error.no_account: Mod downloads need a factorio.com account, and none is set. Nothing was changed. Enter the account, then try again.
mods.error.checksum: A downloaded mod did not match the checksum the mod portal publishes, so Foreman did not use it. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
mods.error.unauthorized: factorio.com refused the username or token, so no mod was downloaded. Nothing was changed. Check the factorio.com account.
mods.error.download_gone: The mod portal no longer has a mod the plan downloads. Nothing was changed. Open the mods again to see the new plan.
mods.error.download_failed: A mod could not be downloaded from the mod portal. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
mods.done: The mods of {world} were changed. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first.

mods.plan.redrawn_conflicts.one: Plan updated: it has a conflict, so it cannot be applied.
mods.plan.redrawn_conflicts.other: Plan updated: it has {count} conflicts, so it cannot be applied.

mods.error.cross_site: This plan was opened from another site, so Foreman did not work it out. Nothing was changed. Choose "Try again" to see the plan.
mods.built_in.line_on: Built in, version {version}: {mods}. Space Age is on, so all of them are on.
mods.built_in.line_off: Built in, version {version}: {mods}. Space Age is off, so {off} are off.

mods.plan.kept.one: {count} other mod stays as it is
mods.plan.kept.other: {count} other mods stay as they are

mods.plan.step.download.one: Download {count} mod from the mod portal and check its checksum.
mods.plan.step.download.other: Download {count} mods from the mod portal and check their checksums.

mods.plan.step.stop: Warn the players, then save and stop {world}.
mods.plan.step.snapshot_kept: Keep the snapshot from {time}, which already covers this change.
mods.plan.step.change_start: Change the mods, then start {world} again.
mods.plan.step.change_stopped: Change the mods. {world} stays stopped, as it is now.
mods.plan.step.fails: If a step fails, the steps after it do not happen.
mods.plan.fix.remove: Remove {mod} as part of this plan

mods.drops.confirm.one: Delete what {mods} built. The snapshot "{label}" keeps a copy.
mods.drops.confirm.other: Delete what these {count} mods built: {mods}. The snapshot "{label}" keeps a copy.

mods.drops.confirm_missing_one: Tick the box to confirm that the game deletes what {mod} built, or cancel.
